description.value: The Chemainus Branch of Vancouver Island Regional Library is a modern civic library that opened in January 2020, the community's third location since the original library debuted in the local Masonic Hall in 1949. It offers free public WiFi, computers, printing, scanning, and research assistance as part of the broader VIRL network spanning Vancouver Island. Wheelchair accessible and centrally located, it makes a practical indoor rest stop for touring cyclists seeking connectivity while passing through Chemainus.
